title: My entity needs a service introduction

scenes.narration: An entity describes data; it doesn't expose an API alone. Even in CAP, introductions matter. Meet the inventory project.
Products gets an ID, title, and stock. Three sample rows are already waiting. At least someone came prepared.
Add InventoryService with a projection of Products. Now there's an API. The read-only annotation says: you may browse, but no shopping.
Run npm run demo. Open the local Products URL, then filter stock above zero. Our keyboard and dock make the shortlist.
Real OData version four results, without a cloud setup. Authentication and deployment are still homework. The service isn't doing those for you.
Try the project and its tests. Which entity needs a service introduction next?

publicationText:
A data model alone does not expose an API in SAP CAP. Add an explicit service projection.

This local example defines Products, exposes a read-only InventoryService, and queries an in-memory SQLite database seeded from CSV. Its checks exercise OData metadata, seeded results, stock filtering, a missing product, and rejected writes.

The setup is a development prototype. Authentication and deployment are separate steps.

Code and setup: Code link pending repository publication
SAP documentation: https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/services/providing-services
